role.title: Welcome to EduBridge AI
role.subtitle: Please select your role to continue. We'll tailor your experience to provide the best tools for your educational journey.
role.studentBody: Access verified curriculum, interactive AI tutoring, and personalized study plans to boost your academic progress.
role.teacherBody: Monitor student progress, assign board-verified content, and utilize AI insights to support every learner.
role.parentBody: Ensure digital safety, follow verified progress reports, and celebrate academic milestones with full transparency.

student.subtitle: Enter your details to access the curriculum.
student.groupHelp: Options depend on the class you selected.
student.reviewIntro: Check these are correct before creating your account.
student.consentBody: For students in Classes 9 & 10, guardian verification is mandatory before accessing AI Tutor features.

login.title: Welcome to EduBridge AI
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue your learning journey.
login.heroBody: Access verified board content, personalized AI tutoring, and culturally resonant study plans designed for your success.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.promptTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to continue securely.
twoFactor.promptEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.
twoFactor.promptBackup: Enter one of the 8-character backup codes you saved.
twoFactor.optionsBody: Select an alternative way to verify your identity.
twoFactor.methodTotpBody: Use the 6-digit code from your app
twoFactor.methodBackupBody: Use one of the 8-character codes you saved
twoFactor.expiredBody: For your security the code request timed out. Sign in again to get a new one.

locked.title: Account Temporarily Locked
locked.body: Too many failed authentication attempts. For your security, this account has been locked.

countdown.finished: The wait is over. You can try again.

errors.badCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.rateLimitedIn: Too many attempts. You can try again in
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

enroll.title: Secure your account
enroll.subtitle: EduBridge AI requires a second factor at sign-in. Choose how you would like to receive your codes.
enroll.totpOptionBody: Scan a QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy or similar
enroll.emailOptionBody: Receive a 6-digit code by email each time you sign in
enroll.mandatoryNote: A second factor is required for every EduBridge AI account. You can change your method later in Settings.
enroll.totpBody: Open your authenticator app, scan the code below, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
enroll.secretLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key instead
enroll.emailBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it below to finish setting up.

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.body: These are shown once. Each code works a single time if you lose access to your second factor.
backupCodes.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the codes above and copy them by hand.
backupCodes.fileHeading: EduBridge AI backup codes — each code works once.
backupCodes.acknowledge: I have saved these codes somewhere safe. I understand they will not be shown again.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmail.bodyUnknown: We sent a verification link to the address you registered with. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmail.spamHint: If it has not arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

verifyEmail.verifyingBody: This will only take a moment.
verifyEmail.verifiedBody: Your email has been verified. Your secure academic environment is ready.
verifyEmail.invalidBody: This verification link is malformed or has already been used. Please request a new one.
verifyEmail.expiredBody: For your security, verification links expire. Please request a new verification email.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your registered email address. We will send you a secure link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent a password recovery link to it.
forgotPassword.spamHint: If it has not arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Create a new, secure password for your account.
resetPassword.doneBody: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.expiredBody: For your security, reset links expire. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.invalidBody: This reset link is malformed or has already been used. Please request a new one.

guardian.title: Parental link required
guardian.subtitle: Students in Classes 9 and 10 need a parent or guardian to approve their account before the AI Tutor unlocks.
guardian.railBody: For students in Classes 9-10, we require a linked Guardian Space to ensure digital safety, maintain academic integrity, and allow parents to monitor verified curriculum progress effectively.
guardian.explainer: Your parent will receive an email, create their own account, and approve the link from it.
guardian.selfLinkError: This has to be your parent or guardian, not your own address.
guardian.pendingBody: We emailed {email}. This page will update as soon as they approve.
guardian.waiting: Waiting for your parent to approve…
guardian.verifiedBody: Your parent has approved the link. Your account is ready.

guardianConfirm.title: Approve your child’s account
guardianConfirm.subtitle: Your child has asked you to approve their EduBridge AI account. Confirming links your accounts.
guardianConfirm.step1: Your child will be able to use the AI Tutor and study tools for their board and class.
guardianConfirm.step2: You will see their progress reports and study activity from your own dashboard.
guardianConfirm.step3: You will not see the content of their tutoring conversations — those stay private to your child.
guardianConfirm.signInFirst: You need your own parent account before you can approve this.
guardianConfirm.confirmedBody: You are now linked to {student}’s account.
guardianConfirm.alreadyBody: This account is already linked. There is nothing more to do here.
guardianConfirm.invalidBody: This invitation link is malformed, expired, or has already been used. Ask your child to send a new one.
guardianConfirm.selfLinkError: An account cannot be its own guardian.
guardianConfirm.notAParentError: Only a parent account can approve this link.

hero.subtitle: A high-performance learning ecosystem grounded in the Pakistani curriculum, empowering students with AI that speaks their language.

students.previewAnswer: Here is that question, worked through one step at a time.

parents.title: Unprecedented Visibility
parents.body: Stay connected with your child's learning journey through non-intrusive, secure progress reports and actionable study insights.
parents.cardMasteryBody: Real-time performance tracking across all boards.

capabilities.title: Core Capabilities
capabilities.subtitle: Built on a foundation of academic excellence and technical security.
capabilities.curriculumBody: Mapped exactly to PCTB and STBB frameworks for board exam success.
capabilities.bilingualBody: Native-level fluency in English and Urdu, including mathematical notation.
capabilities.groundedBody: Sandboxed AI logic keeps answers grounded in verified curriculum content.
capabilities.adaptiveBody: Dynamic difficulty adjustment based on real-time comprehension levels.
